crossRefs.note: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable. When its branch has now become tender, and produces its leaves, you know…
Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.

parallels.note: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable. When its branch has now become tender, and produces its leaves, you know…
When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.

translations.web: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender, and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;
translations.bsb: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
translations.kjv: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:
translations.asv: Now from the fig tree learn her parable: when her branch is now become tender, and putteth forth its leaves, ye know that the summer is nigh;
